title: Align govspend publish shape and review follow-up
reason: Maintainer review asked whether the PR used the printing-press-publish process. This patch records the follow-up that added publish metadata, tightened live dogfood edge cases, refreshed module tidy state, and prepared the PR body for the publish template.
validated_outcome: Publish-package verifier passes for library/other/govspend, publish validate passes, live dogfood passes 19/19 exercised checks, agent-context is available for the live dogfood harness, command help includes Examples sections, USAspending NAICS filters use the documented require object shape, SAM.gov api_key values are redacted from non-2xx HTTP error messages, Grants.gov empty keywords are omitted from request payloads, doctor --live now reports Grants.gov application-level errors returned inside HTTP 200 responses, and vendor/agency invalid search terms return non-zero.
